WhatsNew.Body:
New in this version:

• F10 before saving: the overlay's Save preset and Save single-Mod preset first send F10 to the game window and save once the loader file is stable; if nothing is written within 5 seconds, nothing is saved.

• Overlay refresh: a new Refresh button; the overlay also updates after you enable, disable or switch Mods.

• Mods with many bindings switch faster; directory links, loader state restore and combination presets are no longer marked experimental.

The 4.5 series:

• Save a single-Mod preset from the overlay: click "Save single-Mod preset" in the overlay (Ctrl+Alt+K) and enter a name. It is saved as one of the current Mod's state slots.

• Character avatars: each character on the left of the repository page shows an avatar. Select a character and click the avatar button above the list (or right-click the character) to choose an image or bind it to a character.

• Several Mods per character: select a character and click the toggle to the right of the avatar button. When on, enabling a Mod as a link no longer replaces the character's other Mods.

• Single-Mod state slots: select a Mod and save on the State Slots tab on the right. More… updates, renames, writes Mod defaults, imports a variant file (unverified) and saves whole d3dx_user.ini snapshots.

• F10 hot apply (experimental): with the game window chosen on the Shortcuts page (selected automatically while the game runs) and input on, restoring a slot can reload the loader in place; with "Switch state slots in the overlay" on, the overlay (Ctrl+Alt+K) switches slots with one click.

• New characters reach the character list within a day; restoring a maximized window shrinks it to 80% of the screen.
